# appgatesdp_local_database_identity_provider (Resource)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the object.

### Optional

- `admin_provider` (Boolean) Whether the provider will be listed in the Admin UI or not.
- `block_local_dns_requests` (Boolean) Whether the Windows Client will block local DNS requests or not. Deprecated as of 6.6. Use DNS Policies. Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24.
- `claim_mappings` (Attributes List) The mapping of Identity Provider attributes to claims. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_mappings))
- `device_limit_per_user` (Number) The device limit per user. The existing on-boarded devices will still be able to sign in even if the limit is exceeded.
- `dns_search_domains` (List of String) The DNS search domains to be assigned to Clients of the users in this Identity Provider. Deprecated as of 6.6. Use either the Automatic Client DNS feature in Site DNS resolvers or DNS Policies. Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24.
- `dns_servers` (List of String) The DNS servers to be assigned to the Clients of the users in this Identity Provider. Deprecated as of 6.6. Use either the Automatic Client DNS feature in Site DNS resolvers or DNS Policies. Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24.
- `enforce_windows_network_profile_as_domain` (Boolean) If enabled, Windows Client will configure the network profile as "DomainAuthenticated".
- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `inactivity_timeout_minutes` (Number) (Desktop) clients will sign out automatically after the user has been inactive on the device for the configured duration. Set it to 0 to disable.
- `ip_pool_v4` (String) The IPv4 Pool ID the users in this Identity Provider are going to use to allocate IP addresses for the tunnels.
- `ip_pool_v6` (String) The IPv6 Pool ID the users in this Identity Provider are going to use to allocate IP addresses for the tunnels.
- `min_password_length` (Number) Minimum password length requirement for local users.
- `network_inactivity_timeout_enabled` (Boolean) Whether or not to take network inactivity into account when measuring client inactivity timeout.
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `on_boarding2fa` (Attributes) On-boarding two-factor authentication settings. Leave it empty keep it disabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--on_boarding2fa))
- `on_demand_claim_mappings` (Attributes List) The mapping of Identity Provider on demand attributes to claims. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--on_demand_claim_mappings))
- `tags` (List of String) Array of tags.
- `user_lockout_duration_minutes` (Number) For how long lockout will last for local users.
- `user_lockout_threshold` (Number) After how many failed authentication attempts will a local user be locked out from authenticating again.
- `user_scripts` (List of String) ID of the User Claim Scripts to run during authorization.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Create date.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the entity is protected from manual updates and deletes. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `updated` (String) Last update date.

<a id="nestedatt--claim_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claim_mappings`

Required:

- `attribute_name` (String) The name of the attribute coming from the Identity Provider.
- `claim_name` (String) The name of the user claim to be used in AppGate SDP.

Optional:

- `encrypt` (Boolean) Whether the claim should be encrypted or not.
- `list` (Boolean) Whether the claim is expected to be a list and have multiple values or not.


<a id="nestedatt--on_boarding2fa"></a>
### Nested Schema for `on_boarding2fa`

Required:

- `mfa_provider_id` (String) MFA provider ID to use for the authentication.

Optional:

- `always_required` (Boolean) If enabled, MFA will be required on every authentication.
- `claim_suffix` (String) Upon successful on-boarding, the claim will be added as if MFA remedy action is fulfilled.
- `message` (String) On-boarding MFA message to be displayed on the Client UI during the second-factor authentication.


<a id="nestedatt--on_demand_claim_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `on_demand_claim_mappings`

Required:

- `claim_name` (String) The name of the device claim to be used in Appgate SDP.
- `command` (String) The name of the command.
- `platform` (String) The platform(s) to run the on-demand claim.

Optional:

- `parameters` (Attributes) Depending on the command type, extra parameters to pass to the on-demand claim. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--on_demand_claim_mappings--parameters))

<a id="nestedatt--on_demand_claim_mappings--parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `on_demand_claim_mappings.parameters`

Optional:

- `args` (String) Used as device claim script args/parameters for "runScript" command.
- `name` (String) 'Used for the following commands: "serviceRunning", "processRunning", "runScript". Name of the service, process or device claim script respectively.'
- `path` (String) 'Used for the following commands: "fileSize", "fileExists", "fileCreated", "fileUpdated", "fileVersion", "fileSha512", "regExists", "regQuery".' Path for the file or registry.
